CREATE TABLE "intent" (
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  "detail" TEXT,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "payload" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "resume_policy" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tag" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
